body:
Global deal activity fell during the first nine months of 2026, as cautious dealmaking sentiment continued to weigh on transaction activity worldwide. The total number of deals (comprising mergers and acquisitions (M&A), private equity and venture financing) announced globally declined by 3 percent during first through third quarter 2026 compared with the same period in 2025, according to GlobalData, an intelligence and productivity platform.

An analysis of GlobalData’s Financial Deals Database revealed that the overall decline was primarily driven by weaker M&A activity. The total number of M&A deals announced globally fell by 5 percent year over year during first through third quarter 2026, reflecting continued selectivity among corporate buyers. In contrast, venture financing remained broadly stable, edging up by 0.2 percent year over year, while private equity deal volume increased by 5 percent.

GlobalData의 Financial Deals Database 분석에 따르면, 이러한 전반적인 감소세는 주로 M&A 활동 부진에서 비롯되었다. 2026년 1~3분기 전 세계 M&A 거래 건수는 기업 인수 주체들의 지속적인 신중한 태도를 반영하며 전년 동기 대비 5% 감소했다. 반면, 벤처 금융은 전년 동기 대비 0.2% 소폭 증가하며 대체로 안정세를 유지했고, 사모펀드 거래 볼륨은 5% 증가했다.
